history.hypothesis: Recent DNF rate for a driver
history.sql:
SELECT 
    r.driverId,
    r.date,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN res.statusId = 4 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS recent_dnf_rate
FROM rows r
LEFT JOIN results res ON r.driverId = res.driverId AND res.date < r.date
WHERE res.date >= r.date - INTERVAL 30 DAY
GROUP BY r.driverId, r.date

SELECT 
    r.driverId,
    r.date,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN res.statusId = 4 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS dnf_rate
FROM rows r
LEFT JOIN results res ON r.driverId = res.driverId AND res.date < r.date
GROUP BY r.driverId, r.date

history.hypothesis: Number of races in last 3 months
history.sql:
SELECT 
    r.driverId,
    r.date,
    COUNT(*) AS races_last_3months
FROM rows r
LEFT JOIN results res ON r.driverId = res.driverId AND res.date < r.date
WHERE res.date >= r.date - INTERVAL 90 DAY
GROUP BY r.driverId, r.date

SELECT 
    r.driverId,
    r.date,
    DATE_DIFF('day', MAX(res.date), r.date) AS days_since_last_race
FROM rows r
LEFT JOIN results res ON r.driverId = res.driverId AND res.date < r.date
GROUP BY r.driverId, r.date

history.hypothesis: Recent race frequency and DNF pattern
history.sql:
SELECT 
    r.driverId,
    r.date,
    COUNT(*) AS recent_races,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN res.statusId = 4 THEN 1 END) AS recent_dnf_count
FROM rows r
LEFT JOIN results res ON r.driverId = res.driverId AND res.date < r.date
WHERE res.date >= r.date - INTERVAL 60 DAY
GROUP BY r.driverId, r.date
